profile_text.body:
Lumen Technologies, Inc. is a public company, traded as LUMN, headquartered in Monroe, Louisiana, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000018926. On its own site it describes itself as providing secure networking, edge cloud and AI-ready infrastructure over a global fiber network, and calls itself the enterprise-ready backbone of the AI economy. It says its fiber footprint reaches across markets and reduces latency where it matters, supporting real-time performance, and that its network is designed to connect across high-bandwidth clouds or dynamic multiclouds to support AI workloads.

The site presents customer examples rather than named products. It says built-in automation replaced Arctic Glacier's manual operations, that the New York Yankees use a programmable, consumption-based network with diverse 100G paths and automatic failover, and that American Family Care, an urgent care provider scaling across 26 states, needed an AI-era network to modernize healthcare delivery. For Prometheus Hyperscale, Lumen says it built a private, low-latency network for heavy AI workloads, and that the customer anticipates cutting power consumption by 50% while keeping performance steady. In retail, the site says the network provides security for transactions and protection from DDoS attacks.

The company's litigation exposure is recorded in Louisiana, with a count of 57.
